ns2:course.label: Individual Study
ns2:course.description: Special topics not treated in regularly scheduled classes. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Students may register in more than one section per term. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: One course in Gender and Women's Studies; consent of instructor.
